blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Sunday said she expects Vice President Sara Duterte to attend the budget deliberations of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) just like the heads of other government agencies do. “I expect her to appear, that was explicitly mentioned by Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian during the committee hearing of the OVP budget. We expect heads of agencies to be present during committee hearings up to the plenary,” Hontiveros said in an interview on radio dzBB. “When they’re absent, we take note of that and we tell them we expect them at least during the […]...
